name: SPT Leaderboard
teaser: The Ultimate Leaderboard for SPT. Connect and explore along other SPT players worldwide.
description_html:
Introduction
Warning: This mod connects to an external service owned by the author of this mod to send certain SPT Profile/Request Data from your SPT game (more information on what data the mod sends is in FAQ tab), this service is not maintained by or associated with the SPT Project.

SPT Leaderboard – Rank Globally in SPTarkov!

Highly suggested to pair with Stattrack by AcidPhantasm!

Please READ “Brief Look and Installation” tab or: Join our Discord Server

Key Features:

  • Global Rankings and Statistics – Record many stats like K/D (both PMC and SCAV), survival rate, total kills (PMCs, SCAVs, Bosses), damage dealt, and longest shot distance along with total raids completed, win streaks (current and longest), average engagement distance, and raid history with detailed breakdowns. There’s much more to uncover, but it’s all up to you to find about more.
  • SPTLB Network & Economy – Earn Leaderboard Coins (LC) by playing the game, completing achievements, explore Tarkov Market and spend LC on Tarkov quest keys, barter items or gear, withdraw your bought items right into your game, open cases, report players, and edit your profile. All in one place.
  • Casual Mode and Ranked – Feeling competitive? Or just want access to all features? We’re prepared for both scenarios. Compete with others by SPTLB house rules (SPT Vanilla+) in Ranked mode or get access to all* features with Casual Mode** without restrictions. (*Trading will not be accessible in Casual Mode. **Enable Casual Mode in your F12 BepInEx settings.)
  • BattlePass – Get your unique rewards, progress by playing, unlock Premium and have freedom of choice what to do with the rewards - sell them, withdraw into your SPT game or share some with your friend.
  • Teams – Have your own team tag on the leaderboard and team up with others.
  • Live Data Flow – Your statistics and profile update instantly* after every raid with no manual input required and minimal latency. Just install the mod and watch yourself progress. (*There might be delays due CloudFlare website caching)
  • Weapon Meta & Global Insights – Discover the live weapon stats used by all players along the attachment pick rates and loadouts. Get a peek at global data, most-played maps, and community distributions SPT Leaderboard has ever recorded.
  • Permanent Raid History – Watch your or others Raid History with ease on anyones’, or your profile. Including extra breakdowns.
  • Deep Profile Customization and Awards – Change your profile picture, display last raid statistics, change your About Me or set a custom name, share PMC/SCAV profiles, change your profile theme, level up Leaderboard Level, BattlePass and your Weapon Mastery to unlock even more rewards. Many possibilities are open, just for you!
  • Season End & Reward System – Leaderboard resets with major SPT/mod updates, but past progress remains archived forever you can easily access with a dropdown.
  • Self-Hosting Freedom – It’s your choice to enter a Global Leaderboard, or host it solely for your friends* and other purposes! (*No backend is provided, you’d have to implement an API yourself.)
  • Your Data is truly Yours – Your Unique Secret Token ensures your data is linked to your profile, including stats, and your SPTLB Network profile.

By installing and using this mod, you agree to the Terms of Service (TOS) and License Agreement (LA) of this project.

Cheating/Spoofing will get you temporarily or permanently banned from the SPT Leaderboard. Permanent bans are non-discussable and always final.

Installation and Brief Look

SPT Leaderboard - Installation

This mod installation is can differ depending on your SPT Setup. Here’s a simple guide:

Non-Fika users (default SPT installation) - Drag and drop/replace the contents of the 7z archive.

Fika users who host the server - SPT Leaderboard Server mod must be installed. Client Mod still goes into your game folder where you launch your game and is not required to be installed on headless client if you use that.

Users who use ModSync - This would sync your secret tokens across the clients. We do not support this setup in any way and this may lead to unexpected errors in SPTLB Network including data loss.

Secret Token - what does it do, how to login into SPTLB Network and what you might wanna know

Secret Token - A simple .token file your client mod generates is your key to the Leaderboard. Your secret token is used in many places, but in different shapes - from getting into the leaderboard to creating a profile for you. First of all, and please - backup your secret token somewhere else. There’s many cases when people were reinstalling the mod on the update, only to find out their token doesn’t match anymore.

Your secret token is your password to everything. Once you pass all the checks for legitimacy of the profile and raid data, you’ll appear on Leaderboard and be automatically registered in database. All your profiles you make in the future will have same password (that secret token) and different Profile ID. After making sure Leaderboard registered your profile, you can safely login using that Profile ID and your Secret Token. There’s no register button for this - everything is done on the go, requiring you only to find your secret token inside /BepInEx/plugins/SPTLeaderboard/secret.token and open it with any text editor.

TLDR: The profile IDs you own only matter for item withdrawals when you login. Your token and market token are always the same, meaning you can login into SPTLB Network using any of your registered Profile IDs and same Secret Token.

Market Token - What’s the difference between Secret Token and what is it used for?

Market Token is quite different from secret token - it still belongs to your Secret Token and is also unique. It is used to privately store your SPTLB Network data, like your inventory, notifications, Trust Factor, Achievements, Settings, Friends and more. It’s also used for any item or LC transactions along BattlePass.

How to find it?

Login into SPTLB Network and click on your Profile Picture at top left - then Settings. Scroll down and you’ll see this:

What it is useful for? Not much useful for a casual user, but might be useful for people who might be interested in working with SPTLB API.

Casual Mode - how to use it and what to be aware of

Casual Mode can be found in your BepInEx settings of SPT Leaderboard mod, which upon enabling and finishing a raid puts you in some kind of a ghost state on the leaderboard - you’re free of using any mods you have installed or any other restrictions, but you won’t be ranked with other non-casual players anymore. Almost every other feature will be available for you, except LC and Item Transfers. This is useful for people who just want to get a glimpse at features SPT Leaderboard provides, or they don’t want to bother with their mods to get in.

Be aware - once you enabled this feature, you can no longer turn the profile to non-casual anymore.

SPT Leaderboard - Config System

Client Mod

All settings in a client mod are already well described. Find SPT-Leaderboard tab in BepInEx menu and hover over the settings.

NOTE: Shaded/Gradient themes don’t support backgrounds.

BattlePass Features

All of the Leaderboard BattlePass features are now in SPTLB Network in your profile editor!

Mod Support

This mod automatically detects and supports mods it can if they are installed on your SPT. Here’s a full list of what’s supported:

  • Project Fika - Full support, including multiple player instances simultaneously online and playing using Headless client.
  • WTT - Welcome To Tarkov - Support for its custom achievements including but not limited to achievements page, player profiles, weapon icons and other metadata on modded weapons on both Meta, and player profile pages.
  • StatTrack - Full support. Includes custom tracking player loss of a weapon on the server, preventing from losing previous weapon stats. Will display all weapons on profile page, including player’s most used weapon, and record the statistics on Meta Page.
  • ODT’s Item Info - Only clean weapon names from StatTrack are passed to user profile/meta page. This includes a robust solution from preventing showing of color tags, and other stylings the mod utilizes inside the weapon names.
  • [SAIN] Twitch Players - Players who use this mod will get their name styled in Red color.
  • Pause - Properly displays raid time if player was in the pause. Mainly this is done for Casual Players.
Message For Modders

If you’d like to help this project build the safe environment around its player base and wanna contribute, here’s what you can do. This is by all means is volunteer!

  • Spotted something a casual user haven’t? We’d gladly listen to you at our Discord Server, or GitHub!
  • Wanna add your modded items, cases, or whatever else to SPTLB Network Tarkov Market? You can! Send us a request within our GitHub, or Discord Server so we could discuss it further.
  • Wanna collaborate for a special event? You can, too!
FAQ

Q: I didn’t read the mod page, lost my secret token and reinstalled my SPT 3 times, how can I get my secret token back?
A: The only thing you can now do is start anew with new secret token. SPTLB Team does not offer secret token recovery.

Q: I have done everything and can’t access, or send any raid data. Nothing appears in my SPT game, or website doesn’t load.
A: Try using a different website to see leaderboard - https://sptlb-ru.katrinfoxvr.com. If you don’t send any raid data being sent after raid end, try setting host to that specific address in your F12 BepInEx settings (from https://sptlb.katrinfoxvr.com to https://sptlb-ru.katrinfoxvr.com).

Q: What happens when season ends? Do I completely reinstall the mod? Do everything reset?
A: When season ends, a new mod version will be posted online. Install instructions are always present in the version description/patch notes. Most of the times it’s just a simple drag and drop/replace. As for the season end, here’s what happens:

  • Data that gets WIPED:
    • Your Leaderboard LEVEL (Not the BattlePass!)
    • Your main Leaderboard statistics, KDR, SR, and other statistics along Skill Score
    • Your dynamic profile picture
    • Your raid history, if your raid history is too small or is older than 4 months since last time it’s been used
  • Data that NEVER gets WIPED:
    • Your comments on the profile
    • Your market account that is synced with your secret token
    • Your SPTLB Network inventory, notifications, global stats
    • Your BattlePass, its level and overall progress until new BattlePass is announced
    • Your Leaderboard Profile customization settings
    • Global weapon, item, achievement data that’s been collected

Q: I can’t login to SPTLB Network!
A: You have to complete at least one raid with SPT Leaderboard mod so system can register you. Then, you have use your token and profile ID for logging in. You have to MAKE SURE you’re on the Leaderboard, received in-game success extraction notification or anything else that proves you’re in.

Q: Can I use this mod offline?
A: No, for leaderboard features to work it requires internet connection

Q: What’s the entry requirements for the leaderboard? I don’t wanna get banned!
A: SPT Leaderboard offers a fair place for many players while remaining consistent:

  • No high PMC health, hydration or energy - We allow only Realism Players and health boost on elite health perk
  • No mods considered as cheating tools to gain unfair advantage in statistics - Any sort of radar, revival mods, and mods that give you a very unfair advantage such as overpowered ammunition. Read LA/TOS for more clarity. Or you can view globally banned mods on the main website page of SPT Leaderboard

Q: I get “insert error” error in my SPT Console!
A: The only errors you can get in SPT Console are from SPT Leaderboard Server mod. It does make a connection to our service, and sometimes, due your Firewall settings, VPNs, or ISP can fail to get a response. Nothing to be afraid of - you can safely ignore the error.

Q: Why this mod tells me to update it?
A: This is a live service mod. Project instantly cuts off its old versions on release to prevent bad data being sent to the server. This insures consistency and stability of the project so the player can instantly reach new content on the page and in-game. Sometimes an exception is made, whenever the release is a hotfix, or just a small update that doesn’t require updating right away.

Q: Will this affect my SPT gameplay/performance?
A: Barely. Almost all of the data being processed and sent happens before/after raid. You only send heartbeats during raid to the server and count hits.

Q: How often are my stats updated on the leaderboard?
A: Instantly after end of the raid.

Q: How do I register on the leaderboard? I can’t login!
A: Play one raid. If you didn’t encounter any pop ups in game about your status, and after the end of the raid you see yourself

Q: Does it work with multiple profiles (or Fika)?
A: Yes. The mod has integrated Fika combability, and also supports multiple profiles per Token. However any usage of sync mods such as ModSync, are not supported in any way, and all issues you run into including permanent data loss, is on you or the group of the accounts.

Q: But everyone can just mod the hell out of their stats?
A: Leaderboard, Server and Website comes with various protections, player reports, calibration and own mechanics along Moderation Team. Project explicitly follows and enforces its ToS and LA across all players. SPT Leaderboard also offers “Start from Zero” (since Season 3) and Casual Mode for those, who don’t want to look out for their installed mods and modified game.

Q: What data this mod sends to leaderboard?
A: Raid metrics and SPT profile data. Note that SPT Leaderboard will never collect personal information, everything you see on the leaderboard website is recorded from SPT client. Here’s a full list:
- Your secret token generated by the mod. Never delete it, share with someone you don’t know or change. Always make and keep a backup of it - you will not be able to get back in leaderboard under your own profile you played on before until new season starts. SPTLB Team is not responsible for your token loss.
- Your SPT Profile data and Raid Data
- Its own signature
- Heartbeats to the server with only state and id of a player with timestamp (i.e online, in stash, in raid)
- Request to check for inbox on the server. This is done for profile rewards, withdrawals off the account, or messages regarding profile standing.
For any further questions about your data and what is being sent, visit source code of the client/server mod.

Note: None of personal information gets sent to the server.

LA/TOS

SPT Leaderboard - Legal Agreement / Terms of Service (LA/TOS)

1. Code of Conduct & Fair Play

  • 1.1. Cheating and Exploitation: Any form of cheating, exploiting, or deception is strictly forbidden. This includes manipulating crucial game data (e.g., PMC/SCAV levels, quests, health, hydration, energy) and specific modifications, allowing “double armoring” (wearing armor on top of other armor). The mere presence of disallowed modifications for Ranked players may be deemed a violation at the SPT Leaderboard Team’s discretion.
  • 1.2. Allowed Mods: Only cosmetic, weapon, AI, and quality-of-life (QoL) mods are permitted. Gameplay-altering mods that provide an unfair advantage are strictly forbidden. Examples of prohibited mods include, but are not limited to: god mode, unlimited ammo, faster reloads, extra loot, radars, post-death revival, debug mods, environment mods, and less restrictive armor/headwear options. This applies only to Ranked players.
  • 1.3. Data Integrity: All submitted statistics must come from genuine gameplay. Submitting falsified or edited data is a direct violation and will result in a permanent ban.
  • 1.4. Content Guidelines (Usernames, PFPs, and “About Me”): All user-generated content must be appropriate for a general audience. Content that is offensive, discriminatory, hateful, sexually explicit (NSFW), or politically charged is strictly prohibited. This includes material related to racism, sexual racism, religious intolerance, political extremism, hate speech, harassment, and any form of political discourse or propaganda. Violations will result in removal from the leaderboard, a permanent restriction from profile changes, or a permanent ban.

2. Accounts & Participation

  • 2.1. Account Responsibility: You are solely responsible for all activity under your profile and secret token. Any submission or action made with your token is treated as an action taken by you. Do not share your token, 2FA password or any account details.
  • 2.2. Multi-Account Policy: Players may link multiple accounts under the same token/identifier. However, if any of them violate the rules, all linked accounts will be held responsible. Penalties (including restrictions, or bans) will be applied to the entire group of accounts.
  • 2.3. Account Purpose: Accounts are for genuine player use only. Test accounts, developer accounts, and any accounts not used for legitimate gameplay are prohibited. Violations will result in a profile ban and removal from the leaderboard for the offending account and potentially all linked accounts.
  • 2.4. Casual Mode Exception: While you may use gameplay-altering mods in Casual Mode, exploiting or harming the leaderboard remains prohibited. Casual Mode statistics are not eligible for the main leaderboard rankings.

3. Data Collection, Usage & Privacy

  • 3.1. Client-Side Data Collection (Mod): By installing the client-side mod, you agree that it will collect and transmit gameplay data exclusively during active game sessions. This data includes, but is not limited to: raid statistics (location, coordinates, player states), inventory, gear, profile progression (skills, level, quests, achievements), StatTrack weapon statistics, and Fika Project configurations. The mod will also read and modify files within its installation folder to function. You can disable transmission at any time by uninstalling the mod or disconnecting from the service via F12 BepInEx menu.
  • 3.2. Public Display & Licensing: By submitting data, you grant SPT Leaderboard a non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual license to use, display, and store your statistics publicly on the leaderboard and associated platforms. This applies to all profile data sent to the server and become a non-removable part of the public leaderboard history, with no technical process for deletion.
  • 3.3. Data Privacy & Immutability: The submitted dataset is a non-personal, anonymous snapshot of a gameplay session in a modified environment and does not constitute Personally Identifiable Information (PII). It is not (and must not be) linked to real accounts, passwords, or emails. To maintain integrity, a hashed/obfuscated version of your IP address may be temporarily collected alongside your token for anti-cheat analysis. This hashed IP is stored for no longer than one hour and then automatically erased. Only IPs flagged for malicious activity (e.g., brute-force attacks) are retained for developer review. Raw, unhashed IPs are never logged.

4. Moderation, Enforcement & Penalties

  • 4.1. Profile Standing & Automated Flagging: Profiles flagged by automated systems for suspicious activity or abnormal statistics may be banned without the right to appeal. You are responsible for ensuring your profile remains compliant. Upon identification of such activity, the SPTLB Team may issue a temporary ban pending investigation. The affected user will have the opportunity to appeal and must provide comprehensive evidence of their profile’s legitimacy. Failure to do so will result in a permanent ban.
  • 4.2. Moderation Authority: The Administration and Moderation teams reserve the sole right to review, modify, or remove any entries without prior notice. All moderation decisions are based on the principle of fair play. Decisions are final unless an explicit appeal option is stated.
  • 4.3. Service Management: Developers reserve the right to modify season durations, reset times, or scoring rules as needed. Developers may also modify, suspend, or discontinue the leaderboard service, in whole or in part, temporarily or permanently, without notice and without liability.

5. General Provisions

  • 5.1. Acknowledgment of Rules:: The SPT Leaderboard and its related services are provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis without any warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, timely, secure, or error-free.
  • 5.2. Policy Updates: These Terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of the leaderboard following an update implies acceptance of the new terms.

6. Limitation of Liability & Disclaimer
